goal: Prove a renderer-free WoW 1.12.1 build 5875 client can authenticate and enter a world session as an Android x86_64 executable in a PC emulator before implementing read-only Auction House and Mail support.
notes: Isolated emulator-first probe. It does not modify current MarketWorker/AUX DLL ownership, parallel_candidate, loader or updater delivery. POC-01 ends at SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD; AH read-only is intentionally deferred until protocol login succeeds on the real server.
